Racks are built from your devices. Open the Device Builder on the Racks tab.
Click New rack, give it a name, and an article key if you use them. The key is optional.
Choose the height in units. A rack can never be lower than what is in it.
On the right are your devices. Click the plus to add one at the first free position, or drag it to the exact place you want.
Half width devices, like the LumiNode four, sit two side by side. Fill gaps adds black blind plates next to them.
The summary shows how much space is used. Close the builder, and place the rack in a DB.
Or build a rack right here: Custom rack. Choose how many panels, nodes, splitters and switches it holds, and PatchLab places them. No article key is needed.
Click Build and place, and the rack is in the DB, with its own name, and the LK and the lines of this DB are patched onto it.
